concerns.location: tasks.md:Dependencies section — 'Execution order: T001 → T002 → (T003 ∥ T004 thin pass) → …'
concerns.text: T004 consumes `data/processed/sim_catalog.csv`, which is produced only by T003 ('comparing data/processed/obs_point_estimates.csv vs data/processed/sim_catalog.csv'). Declaring T003 ∥ T004 as parallel is a consumer-before/alongside-producer violation: if T004 runs before T003 completes, its input does not exist. Fix the execution order to T001 → T002 → T003 → T004 (T003 may still run in parallel with T002's tail, but T004 must be strictly after T003), or have T004's driver invoke the generator first as its own step.
